Needs Android 11 or newer. VSpace activates a shell-uid helper through Wireless Debugging, an Android 11+ feature.
Open Settings → About phone → Software information, then tap “Build number” seven times until it confirms Developer options is unlocked. Return here when done.
Enable Wireless Debugging in Developer options, then return — VSpace reconnects automatically.

In Wireless Debugging on this phone, tap “Pair device with a pairing code”. The dialog shows a 6-digit code — pull down the notification shade *over the dialog* and type the code into the VSpace pairing notification. Don\'t leave the dialog: VSpace pairs while it\'s still in front. The fields below are a fallback if your shade doesn\'t cooperate — they need the code *and* the port from the dialog.
Looking for the local ADB service…
Connecting to the local ADB service…
Pairing failed — check the code and that the “Pair device” dialog is still open, then try again.
Enter the 6-digit code and the port from the pairing dialog.
Lets you enter the wireless-debugging pairing code from the notification shade.
Type the 6-digit code from the Wireless Debugging pair dialog. Pull this shade down over the dialog and answer here — VSpace pairs while the dialog is still in front.
